column1: S1: Answer list questions across the document
column6:
As a support agent, I want to ask 'which services are free?' and get every one, so that I don't give a customer an incomplete answer.

Acceptance criteria:
- List, filter and maximum questions are routed to the knowledge-graph tools.
- Recall >= 90% on the 6 list questions and 6 new held-out list questions (RAG today: 33.3%; graph tools: 100%).
- Single-fact pass rate stays >= 93.8%.

column1: S2: Confidence that predicts correctness, or no label
column6:
As an account holder, I want the confidence label to mean something, so that I know when to double-check.

Acceptance criteria:
- Replace the self-reported label with a signal measured on the golden set; show it only if AUROC >= 0.75 (today 0.50: 'high' on all 44 answers, including 3 wrong).
- Until then the UI shows the quoted evidence and no confidence label.

column1: S3: Fix the scorer before changing the model
column6:
As the team, we want the pass rate to reflect what users would accept.

Acceptance criteria:
- Meaning-level check (normalised numbers/units + LLM judge) for paraphrase cases; every disagreement with the strict scorer reviewed by hand.
- para-03 and para-04 (correct answers marked partial) pass; no wrong answer starts passing.

column1: S4: Find document-level facts such as the effective date
column6:
As an account holder, I want to ask when the terms took effect, so that I know they apply to me.

Acceptance criteria:
- fact-05 passes (today: wrongly answered 'Not found').
- The chunk with the document header is retrievable; no other case regresses.

As a support agent, I want an answer in a few seconds, so that I can use it while the customer waits.

Acceptance criteria:
- Median latency < 4 s and p90 < 8 s on the golden set (today: median 8.4 s, 15 of 48 over 10 s).
- Pass rate stays >= 93.8%.

column1: S6: Usage analytics without storing questions
column6:
As the product owner, I want to know how the bot is used and where it fails, so that I can prioritise with data.

Acceptance criteria:
- One structured log event per question: time, answer model, latency, answered/not found/refused, guardrail outcome. Never the question text.
- Dashboard of daily questions, not-found rate and latency.

As a compliance reviewer, I want exemptions captured as reliably as charges.

Acceptance criteria:
- Exemption F1 >= 85% against hand-checked facts (today 57.1%; charges 100%).
